package argojob
import("encoding/json";"os";"path/filepath";"testing";wfv1 "github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v4/pkg/apis/workflow/v1alpha1")
func TestExportPriorityControllerInputs(t *testing.T){
 write:=func(dir,name string,wf *wfv1.Workflow){t.Helper();data,err:=json.MarshalIndent(wf,"","  ");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};if err=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join("/proof",dir,name),data,0600);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}}
 old:=func(dir,name string)*wfv1.Workflow{t.Helper();data,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("testdata",dir,name));if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};var wf wfv1.Workflow;if err=json.Unmarshal(data,&wf);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};return &wf}
 for _,shape:=range []string{"dedicated-tools","none","container","script","containerset","sidecars","inline-dag","inline-steps"}{
  r:=isolationControllerRequest(t,shape);if err:=recoverHelperStorage(old("isolation-argo4.0.8",shape+"-workflow.json"),&r);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  wf,err:=Build(testConfig(),r);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};write("isolation",shape+"-workflow.json",wf)
 }
 for _,shape:=range wifControllerShapes{c,r:=wifControllerInput(t,shape);if err:=recoverHelperStorage(old("wif-argo4.0.8",shape+"-workflow.json"),&r);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};wf,err:=Build(c,r);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};write("wif",shape+"-workflow.json",wf)}
 for _,shape:=range []string{"container","script"}{write("nonroot",shape+".json",nonrootBuiltWithHelperPolicy(t,shape=="script","128Mi",legacyHelperStoragePolicy))}
}
